findings.description: The user-data script interpolates the database username and var.password into a local PHP configuration file. This exposes reusable credentials through Terraform/user-data access and to anyone who compromises the instance.
The instance explicitly sets storage_encrypted = false, so RDS database storage and its storage-level artifacts are not encrypted at rest.

The EC2-assumable application role is granted s3:*, ec2:*, and rds:* on every resource. Compromise of the application instance would provide broad access to cloud resources and data, including actions that can enable further privilege escalation.

No RDS parameter enforces encrypted MySQL transport (for example, require_secure_transport), while the application connects with mysqli without TLS configuration. Database credentials and application data can therefore traverse the network without encryption.
